RAO 2-1

The Moderator shall preside at all sessions of the Assembly except when he may invite another commissioner to act temporarily as the presiding officer.

RAO 2-2

The Moderator shall call the succeeding Assembly to order and preside over its sessions until a successor has been elected. Ordinarily he shall present a retiring Moderator’s sermon or exhortation. If the Moderator is unable to act, the Stated Clerk shall call the Assembly to order and preside over its sessions until a Moderator has been elected.

RAO 2-3

Any former moderator attending a General Assembly shall have the privilege of the floor.
